items.description:
Anton Boswel & Associates is a labour law and human resources firm based in Wingate Park, Pretoria, built on more than 20 years of experience optimising clients' labour and HR functions. The practice takes over day-to-day HR management for client organisations, covering job evaluation and remuneration consulting, organisational restructuring, and project and procurement management, freeing up internal resources so a business can refocus where it is needed most.

On the labour relations side, the firm has built up deep experience preventing and resolving disputes with unions and workers' organisations, including CCMA representation, and offers negotiation, facilitation, mediation and soft-skills training to help organisations manage conflict before it escalates. From its Wingate Park base, the practice works to limit the downtime and lost revenue that labour disputes can cause, giving client businesses a single point of contact for both HR optimisation and dispute resolution.

Apollo Brush is a Pretoria manufacturer and supplier of brooms, mops, brushes and floor-care equipment, based in Kirkney, Booysens. Its range covers household and platform and yard brooms, rakes, dustpans, and mop-and-broom combinations, alongside painting supplies such as paint brushes, rollers and refills, scrapers and household gloves, sold to both individual customers and the trade.

The business is BBBEE certified and supplies product in bulk to businesses that get in touch directly, alongside an ongoing search for new affiliates interested in stocking its range. Operating from Johnson Street in Kirkney, Pretoria, and open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm, Apollo Brush serves as a dependable local source for cleaning equipment and painting supplies for households, contractors and resellers alike.

ARB Electrical Wholesalers Pretoria North is a branch of one of Southern Africa's largest black-empowered electrical wholesalers, trading from President Steyn Street in Pretoria North as one of several Gauteng branches that include Centurion, Pretoria Gezina, Pretoria East, Silver Lakes and Pretoria West. The branch stocks cable and cabtyre, flat twin and earth and housewire, along with cable accessories such as glands, heatshrink, joints and terminations, and lugs and ferrules.

Beyond core cabling, the branch supplies low-voltage products, overhead line equipment and lighting, and offers in-house solar technical support for customers moving into renewable power. Customers can also track existing orders online or use ARB's store locator to find their nearest branch. Trading Monday to Friday from 7am to 4:30pm and Saturday mornings, the Pretoria North branch serves contractors, resellers and households across the northern side of the city.

items.description:
Avon Packaging Convertors is a flexible packaging manufacturer based in Waltloo, Pretoria, formed in late 2024 when Avon Packaging acquired Flexible Packages Convertors out of business rescue. Trading on as part of the wider Avon Packaging group, the company continues the flexible-packaging manufacturing operation at the same Waltloo site, carrying over the production capacity and client base of the business it replaced.

The company holds ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000 V6 certification, reflecting formal quality and food-safety management systems in its production process, and operates under a BBBEE certificate alongside a stated transformation strategy. Based on Marks Street in Waltloo, Pretoria, Avon Packaging Convertors positions itself as a certified, group-backed flexible packaging supplier for businesses that need consistent, accredited manufacturing rather than a smaller uncertified operator.

AWD Law is a Pretoria conveyancing and property law firm based in Boardwalk Manor, with more than two decades of conveyancing experience handling property transfers, bond registrations and the establishment of sectional title schemes. The firm also practises notarial services and administers deceased estates, giving it a focus that extends beyond transfers into the wider legal work that property and estate matters typically require.

Its website offers a bond and transfer cost calculator so clients can estimate costs before instructing the firm, along with a dedicated explanation of how conveyancer's fees are calculated. The practice is BBBEE certified and maintains a team page and blog setting out its areas of expertise. From its Olympus Drive offices in Boardwalk Manor, AWD Law serves homeowners, property investors and estate administrators across Pretoria needing conveyancing or related legal support.

Babelegi Workwear and Industrial Supplies has manufactured industrial workwear since 1985, trading from Rosslyn East in Akasia on the northern edge of Pretoria. Its range includes protective overalls and work clothing for industrial and trade customers, alongside products such as its own Babelegi Parka Jacket, designed to keep workers warm and comfortable through cold or demanding conditions on site.

As both a manufacturer and retailer, the business supplies finished workwear and industrial supplies directly from its Rosslyn East premises, with a following of more than 9,000 built up over four decades of trading. The company is also listed on business directories under its Rosslyn address, confirming its standing as an established local supplier. Based in Rosslyn, Akasia, Babelegi serves industrial, construction and trade customers across the greater Pretoria area needing durable workwear and related supplies.

items.description:
Bay Leaf Restaurant is a halaal-certified Indian restaurant in Laudium serving authentic North Indian cuisine for lunch and dinner, with a takeaway menu and vegetarian options alongside its sit-down a la carte offering. Free, secure parking is available on site, and the restaurant caters for functions of any size, from birthday parties and kitchen teas to weddings, preparing dishes it says leave guests and their families wanting more.

For customers who prefer to eat at home, Bay Leaf offers delivery through Mr D, with Uber Eats delivery also in the pipeline. The restaurant is one of three Bay Leaf branches operating across Gauteng, giving it the backing of an established small group while still trading as a standalone eatery on Tangerine Street in Laudium. It suits diners after Indian comfort food, whether dining in, taking away or ordering a catered function.

Bean Biking Coffee Company is a mobile coffee business operating out of a tuk-tuk around Pretoria, founded by two students who set out to bring gourmet, espresso-based coffee to wherever people are gathering. The business uses 100% arabica beans across its espresso-based menu, serving functions, events and markets rather than running from a single fixed shop front.

Based around Marais Street in Brooklyn, Muckleneuk, the tuk-tuk trades Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm and has built a loyal following on Instagram following its day-to-day moves around the city. Bean Biking suits event organisers and market coordinators looking to add a mobile specialty coffee offering to their function, as well as anyone who spots the tuk-tuk out and about and fancies a proper cup of coffee on the go.

items.description:
The Blue Crane Restaurant and Bar sits next to the Austin Roberts Bird Sanctuary in Nieuw Muckleneuk and has recently been renovated under new ownership and management. The venue offers a formal dining area beside a fireplace, a coffee deli on the outside deck of the extended restaurant, and an upstairs bar with its own deck overlooking the dam and bird sanctuary, giving guests a choice of settings depending on the occasion.

A newly built Boma area caters for functions and bonfire evenings, and the restaurant hosts birthdays, kitchen teas, bridal showers, graduations and weddings, with a custom-built jungle gym on site for younger guests. Based in Nieuw Muckleneuk, Pretoria, the Blue Crane suits both casual diners after a meal with a view and groups planning a private or corporate function in a renovated, garden-facing venue.

Blue Wave Tent & Tarp SA has manufactured PVC and ripstop tarpaulins, covers, tents and inflatables since 1996, working from Boekenhoutskloof on the edge of Pretoria. Its tarpaulin and cover range is produced to customer specification from A-grade material, including custom truck tarpaulins, pool covers and boat covers, while its tent range spans pyramid, stretch, chalet, and peg-and-pole tents, all able to be custom made in a chosen shape, size and colour.

The company also manufactures inflatable products in various shapes and sizes for private or commercial use, again built from A-grade material to its own specifications. Blue Wave positions its offering around quality materials, an experienced manufacturing team for speedy delivery, and competitive pricing, and delivers throughout South Africa as well as into neighbouring African countries from its Pretoria manufacturing base.

items.description:
Boom Slope South Africa provides owner-supervised tree services to residential, industrial and farming properties from its base in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion. Its core tree work covers felling, trimming and pruning, stump removal and palm tree care, carried out by an experienced team that aims to leave sites safe and tidy once work is complete.

Beyond tree felling, the business offers general site clearing and garden refuse removal, as well as broader garden services including landscaping, water features and instant lawn installation, giving it a wider offering than tree work alone. Operating from Van Riebeeck Avenue in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, Boom Slope South Africa serves homeowners, industrial sites and farms across the area needing tree removal or ongoing garden upkeep handled by a single, experienced contractor.

Bosvark Development is an empowered construction company based in Monavoni, Centurion, with an array of competences spanning civil construction and building infrastructure. The business's civil construction work includes civil engineering design, bulk earthworks and road construction, alongside water supply and sewer infrastructure, covering the groundwork phase that larger developments depend on.

On the buildings side, the company carries out building construction work and project management, overseeing projects through from design and civil works to completed structures. Trading from Ashwood in Monavoni, Centurion, Bosvark Development serves clients across the Monavoni and wider Centurion area who need a single contractor able to handle both the civil engineering and building construction sides of a development.

Bron Joinery is a Pretoria carpentry and joinery company based in Koedoespoort Industrial, manufacturing a wide range of custom wooden doors and windows for residential and commercial properties. Its door range covers folding and stacking doors, sliding doors, solid and glass doors, pivot doors and garage doors, together with matching door frames and weather bars for a complete, weather-sealed fit.

On the window side, the company manufactures small-pane and full-pane windows, matching fanlight versions of each, and top-hung windows, giving customers a range of styles to match different home designs. Bron Joinery also offers stackable wooden crates and equipment hire alongside its core joinery manufacturing. Based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, the company serves homeowners, builders and contractors looking for custom-made wooden doors and windows rather than standard off-the-shelf sizes.

Bupo Animal Health is an international South African company that has manufactured, imported and distributed veterinary pharmaceutical products and feed additives since 1988, based in Silverton, Pretoria. The business has invested in its own factory's processing capacity for liquids, powders and feed additives, supplying products for poultry, swine, ruminants and companion animals under GMP-certified, ISO 9001-accredited production.

Beyond its South African base, Bupo Animal Health operates its own branches in Mozambique, Kenya, Egypt, Morocco and Nigeria, and works alongside a wider distribution network across the rest of the African continent, with a stated motto of adapting swiftly to the needs of African emerging markets. Based in Silverton, Pretoria, the company serves livestock producers and animal health distributors across Africa, and says it is also working on expanding further afield.

items.description:
Bus Factor is a transport operator based on Tulip Street in Monavoni, Centurion, providing bus and vehicle hire using its own fleet rather than sub-contracted vehicles. The company transports people of any group size, from individual travellers and tourists to corporate clients, schools and sports teams, tailoring its service to what each booking requires.

Operating under the Automotive Transports and Car Rental Agencies categories, Bus Factor positions itself as able to help with transport requirements of any scale, big or small, drawing on its own vehicles to keep bookings flexible. Trading on weekdays from Monavoni, Centurion, the company serves schools, sports clubs, tour groups and corporate clients across the greater Centurion and Pretoria area needing group transport without engaging a separate rental agency and driver.

Business With Us is a Centurion-based technology services company offering web hosting, email hosting and website design, alongside media hosting for music streaming and podcast content and broader multimedia editing covering audio, image and video work. Its graphic design service covers logos, artwork, posters, banners, office stationery and corporate branding, supported by printing for finished branded material.

The company also handles document development, from drafting official documents and stationery to proofing and scripting, and sells laptops, computers and mobile devices and accessories, backed by device repair, installation and remote IT support. Operating out of Die Hoewes, Centurion, from 7am to 7pm on weekdays and Saturdays, Business With Us serves small businesses and individuals needing hosting, design, hardware and IT support from one local technology provider.

Bvumbi Ready Mix is a black-owned, youth-led ready-mix concrete supplier founded in 2019, serving builders, engineers, developers and architects from its base near Zwavelpoort on the eastern edge of Pretoria. The company produces concrete across grades from 10 MPa to 60 MPa, tailoring each mix to a project's specifications rather than offering a single standard product.

Alongside concrete supply, Bvumbi Ready Mix offers concrete pumping using mobile and stationary pumps, allowing efficient placement on large-scale projects or in hard-to-reach locations, and provides a free site inspection covering concrete choice, volume calculations and delivery access before a project begins. Based in Pretoria East, the company serves construction clients across the region who need ready-mix concrete delivered and placed without separately sourcing a pumping contractor.

CHS Quantity Surveyors is a Pretoria quantity surveying practice registered with the South African Council for Quantity Surveyors, originally established in 1980 and now marking more than 40 years in the profession. The practice's preconstruction work focuses on the financial viability of a project, preparing contract documents to the latest JBCC requirements and giving clients financial projections before building begins.

During construction, CHS manages cost through contract administration, valuing completed work and arranging payments to the appropriate parties to reduce the risk of project overruns, before concluding each job with a final account settlement between client and contractor. Based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, the practice draws on a combined team experience of more than 40 years to deliver quantity surveying services on projects across Southern Africa.

C4 Africa Group is an integrated livestock solutions company based in Irene, Centurion, offering veterinary management and consulting, farm planning and nutrition, laboratory services, and vaccine and product supply, and has served clients since 2009. Its team of professional consultants works specifically in intensive animal production, aiming to give clients independent, unbiased and scientifically based advice rather than advice tied to a single product line.

Because the C4 team is built around mobility, it is able to travel to clients anywhere in Africa and beyond from its central Gauteng base, rather than requiring clients to come to a fixed premises. The company frames long-term client relationships as key to helping clients reach their goals, positioning itself as an empowerment-focused partner to the African livestock industry. Based in Irene, Centurion, it serves farmers and livestock businesses across the continent.

Cajees Cycle Centurion is a bicycle shop trading from Shop 11 in the Byls Bridge Shopping Centre in Highveld, Centurion, part of the wider Cajees Cycle chain with further branches in Fourways, Boksburg, Strubensvalley and Horizon View. The Centurion store stocks mountain and road bikes alongside cycling accessories, giving riders in the area a dedicated local source for bikes and gear rather than relying on a branch elsewhere in Gauteng.

The shop runs its own in-store workshop, including a shock-servicing centre for suspension components, so customers can have bikes serviced and repaired at the same premises where they buy them. Trading from Bloukrans Road in Highveld Extension 13, Cajees Cycle Centurion serves recreational and serious cyclists across Centurion who need bikes, accessories or workshop support from a single local outlet within the wider Cajees network.

Calisto's Eldo Square (Halaal) is a SANHA-certified halaal restaurant at the Eldo Square Shopping Centre in Eldoglen, Centurion, specialising in Portuguese and seafood dishes made fresh to order. The branch is part of the wider Calisto's chain, launched in 1992, which has continued expanding through franchise opportunities, including new locations opened alongside this already-trading Eldo Square store.

Beyond its flame-grilled Portuguese chicken, seafood and steak menu, the restaurant is known locally for its milkshake range, with flavours including Oreo, cheesecake, strawberry, Bar One, Nutella, and banana and peanut butter. Operating as a family-style restaurant on Willem Botha Drive in Eldo Glen, Centurion, Calisto's Eldo Square serves halaal diners looking for Portuguese flame-grilled food, seafood or a milkshake alongside their meal.

CalPharm (Pty) Ltd is a pharmaceutical contract manufacturer in Hennopspark, Centurion, with more than 30 years of experience and over 500 million products manufactured to date. The company is SAHPRA licensed, cGMP certified and SAPC A-grade certified, and offers encapsulation services spanning hard and soft gelatine capsules, vegetarian capsules, custom formulations and quality testing for clients needing contract capsule production.

Its tableting division handles immediate-release, extended-release, chewable and effervescent tablet formats, while its packaging service covers blister packing, counting and filling, labelling and secondary packaging, giving clients a full manufacturing-to-packaging service under one roof. Alongside its contract manufacturing operation, CalPharm runs the attached Nutrking Supplement Shop, selling pharmaceutical products and supplements from the same Hennopspark site, serving both bulk manufacturing clients and retail supplement customers.

Candlewoods Guest House occupies a Victorian-style heritage building dating to 1859 within Candlewoods Country Estate in the Centurion and Midrand area, offering luxury accommodation across 10 rooms in the main house plus two self-catering houses. Guests have access to an outdoor pool and a daily buffet breakfast, with the guesthouse positioning itself around opulent amenities and attentive service for both business and leisure stays.

The guesthouse also runs its own conferencing operation, with half-day and full-day packages available and pricing provided on request, making it a venue for corporate events as well as overnight stays. A separate Candlewoods Boutique Venue within walking distance hosts weddings and larger functions. Based in Candlewoods Country Estate, Centurion, the guest house suits travellers wanting a heritage setting alongside modern conferencing facilities.

items.description:
Cater Warehouse is a wholesale catering supplier based in Capital Park, Pretoria, established in 2000 and grown from an original team of three staff to 32. The business supplies groceries, kitchen equipment and hardware to the catering trade, alongside cleaning products, packaging, personal hygiene items, plastics and protective wear, covering most of what a food-service operation needs from one supplier.

Its customer base spans government departments, corporate companies, schools and the hospitality industry, with both delivery and in-store collection available for orders. Operating from Steve Biko Road in Capital Park, Pretoria, Cater Warehouse serves catering and hospitality businesses across the city looking to source groceries, equipment and consumables from a single wholesale supplier rather than multiple vendors.

Cathy van Onselen is a Doornpoort-based entrepreneur running side businesses in the beauty, wellness and entrepreneurship space alongside full-time work at a Christian radio station since 2021. Before moving into business, she served in the South African Police Service for 14 years, an experience she says shaped a direct approach to overcoming setbacks rather than making excuses for them.

Her offering centres on mentorship and coaching aimed at personal transformation, drawing on the belief that people have the ability to change their own circumstances rather than waiting for things to change around them. Operating from Doornpoort, Pretoria, the practice suits clients looking for personal development coaching from someone balancing an established day job with hands-on experience building her own ventures from scratch.

Cell Time is a mobile device accessory retailer at Raslouw Lifestyle Centre in Centurion, selling smartphone cases, screen protectors and chargers for brands including Apple, Samsung, Huawei and Xiaomi. The store carries Nillkin's range of smart, simple device accessories alongside ESR Tech's MagSafe-focused cases and wireless chargers, giving customers a choice across several established accessory brands rather than a single own-brand range.

Its shelves also stock AMAZINGTHING accessories, which pair durable phone cases with advanced charging products, and FOTOPRO photography accessories, extending the store's range beyond phone cases into wider mobile and tech lifestyle products. Cell Time additionally sells ergonomic laptop stands and monitor risers for home and office setups. Trading from Raslouw Lifestyle Centre, Centurion, the store serves customers needing device protection, charging accessories or small office ergonomic products.

items.description:
Centurion Signs is a signage and printing company based at Diamond Park in Hennopspark, Centurion, designing, printing and installing a wide range of branded material through its own print studio. Its printed products and signage solutions cover vinyl banners, acrylic and chromadek signage and flatbed printing, while its vehicle branding, pull-up banners and point-of-sale displays round out its offering for businesses needing visual branding across multiple formats.

The company also runs an online shop for customers wanting to order signage and printed products without an in-person consultation. Based on Jakaranda Street in Hennopspark and open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, Centurion Signs serves businesses across Centurion needing signage, vehicle branding or point-of-sale material produced and installed by a single local supplier.

Centurion Technology Support Services, trading as Centech, provides IT hardware, software and managed IT services from its office in Zwartkop, Centurion, and has been established since 2004. Its service lines include custom software development, data centre hosting, IT consulting and custom IoT software, alongside server management and system security work for business clients.

The company also supplies networking, cloud services, cybersecurity and disaster recovery planning, and runs an online shop for IT hardware and accessories alongside its services business. Based in Zwartkop, Centurion, and trading Monday to Friday, Centech serves businesses and government organisations across the area that need IT infrastructure, custom software or ongoing managed support from a single local provider.

Checkers Gezina Galleries is a supermarket trading from the corner of Frederika Street (10th Avenue) and Nico Smith Street in Gezina, inside the Gezina Galleries shopping centre. The store runs a deli counter, in-store bakery, dedicated meat market, fish counter and cheese counter, giving shoppers fresh-food departments alongside its general grocery range.

For customers who prefer not to shop in person, the branch offers Sixty60 rapid delivery, bringing groceries to the door in as little as an hour through the Checkers app. Trading from Gezina Galleries in Gezina, Pretoria, the store serves households across the suburb looking for a full-service supermarket with dedicated fresh-food counters and the option of fast online delivery.

City Drilling provides borehole drilling, servicing, water testing and water storage solutions for residential, agricultural and commercial clients across Gauteng, North West, Mpumalanga and Limpopo, based in Derdepoort, Pretoria. For tight urban sites, the company uses a drilling rig only 2.2 metres high, built specifically to work in city gardens and other limited spaces where a standard drilling rig would not fit.

Its services run from initial water surveys and precise borehole siting through to drilling, casing in steel or PVC, and ongoing servicing and repairs of existing boreholes, giving clients a single provider across a borehole's full lifespan. The company frames a private borehole around control over water supply, cost savings and protection from municipal water shortages. Based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, City Drilling serves homeowners, farmers and businesses across four provinces looking to secure an independent water supply.

items.description:
CMV Group is an accounting and financial advisory firm with offices in Pretoria's Olympus area and four further South African locations, offering tax consulting, deceased estate administration, wills and trusts, and B-BBEE advisory services. Beyond its core accounting practice, the firm's service lines extend into IT solutions and secretarial and POPIA compliance support, giving clients a broader base of administrative and regulatory services alongside standard accounting work.

The group also acts as a managing agent, and maintains a corporate social investment profile alongside its client-facing services. Based at Midas Avenue in Olympus, Pretoria, CMV Group serves individuals and businesses needing tax, estate, compliance and B-BBEE advisory support from a single firm with a presence across several South African centres.

Coquis Men's Outfitters has sold men's clothing and footwear since 1970, trading from Wonderboom South, Pretoria, under the tagline "Where service and experience counts." The store stocks shirts, jackets, trousers and suits alongside leather boots and shoes from brands including Florsheim, Grasshoppers and RVCA, serving men looking for both formal wear and casual, everyday clothing.

Customers can order online or visit the Wonderboom South store in person for personalised styling advice and expert fitting, with free alterations included on in-store purchases. Having served South African men for more than five decades, Coquis built its reputation on personal service and quality rather than volume, and continues to combine its physical store with an online shop for customers who prefer to order ahead.

Cornico, founded in 2008 and based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, manufactures and supplies polystyrene cornice and timber mouldings, producing its own stock in-house rather than reselling imported product. Its range covers traditional cove cornice and bull nose skirting through to modern moulding styles, giving customers a choice between classic and contemporary finishes for any room.

The company also manufactures timber boards and traditional decking, extending its offering beyond cornice and skirting into broader timber trim work. Because Cornico produces its own stock, it places no restrictions on order size and can guarantee continuity of supply for both small home renovations and larger trade orders. Based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, the company supplies homeowners, builders and trade customers looking for cornice, skirting and timber mouldings from a single manufacturer.

Courier Solutions has specialised in urgent, time-critical freight since it was established in September 1997, operating from 21 centres across South Africa that reach more than 2,800 destinations nationwide. Its service range covers in-city and inter-city same-day delivery, a same-day drive-away service for areas not served by air, and an overnight service guaranteeing delivery to main centres by 8:30am the following morning.

For less urgent shipments, the company offers an economy service covering delivery within 48 to 72 hours, alongside international express courier delivery worldwide. Its brokerage division provides dedicated large vehicles, including tail-lift and crane trucks, for non-courier freight that needs more than a standard courier van. Based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, Courier Solutions serves businesses across South Africa needing anything from a same-day local delivery to international freight.

Couzyn Hertzog & Horak Inc is a Pretoria law firm with a history dating back to 1929, now drawing on more than 97 years of legal practice from its offices in Nieuw Muckleneuk. The firm practises across criminal law, litigation, commercial law, aviation, estates and trusts, property law, family law, tax, employment and insolvency law, giving it a broad spread of practice areas under one roof.

Its client base spans private individuals, small companies, listed entities, government agencies, financial institutions, retail corporations, healthcare organisations, universities and real estate developers from across South Africa, reflecting the range of matters the firm is instructed on. Based on Middel Street in Nieuw Muckleneuk, Pretoria, Couzyn Hertzog & Horak serves clients needing individualised, client-centric legal advice across a wide span of practice areas from a single, long-established firm.

Cozy-Panda Logic is a boutique software studio based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, building business websites, custom web and mobile applications and e-commerce stores for South African businesses. Its e-commerce builds integrate local payment gateways including PayFast and Yoco, and its fixed-price packages start from R18,000, giving clients cost certainty before a project begins rather than an open-ended hourly quote.

The studio offers full-stack development from front-end to back-end and database work, alongside UI and UX design, and turns quotes around within 48 hours of enquiry. Completed projects come with three months of free post-launch support, covering early fixes and adjustments once a site or application goes live. Based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, Cozy-Panda Logic serves small and growing South African businesses wanting custom software built and priced in rand rather than through an offshore developer.

Craft Homes has developed residential property across South Africa since 1993, with projects spanning contemporary bachelor apartments to generous family residences across Gauteng and along the banks of the Vaal River. Operating from Hazeldean, Pretoria, the developer builds homes, apartments, duplexes and retirement estate properties aimed at a range of budgets and life stages rather than a single type of buyer.

The company works with a consistent group of contractors, consultants and suppliers across its developments, aiming for openness at every stage of a project and consistency in delivery, under what it calls a "Developing Trust" approach to homebuilding. With decades of completed projects behind it, Craft Homes serves buyers across Gauteng and the Vaal River area looking for a residential developer with a long, continuous track record rather than a newly formed one.

Creative Collective is an experiential marketing agency based in Raslouw, Centurion, specialising in event activations, brand experiences and shopping centre promotions for more than 100 brands to date. Its licensed activation work has included campaigns for Disney, Universal Studios and LEGO, giving the agency experience running branded experiences under the rules and requirements that major licensed properties require.

Past projects span artisanal arts-and-crafts workshops at Gateway, an Easter chocolate cafe activation at Sandton City, a live music series at DQ, a sales-drive launch event for Steyn City's 104 on Creek development, and Sunlight-branded photo rooms built to capture that brand's identity. Based in Raslouw, Centurion, Creative Collective serves brands and shopping centres needing activations, promotions or licensed character experiences planned and run from concept through to the event itself.

CW Pharmaceuticals is a contract manufacturer of cosmetics, skincare and personal care products based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, offering custom formulation backed by stability testing since 2006. The company develops private-label and OEM products for clients, taking a formulation from early development work through to a stable, market-ready product rather than only producing to an existing recipe.

Its production capability covers scalable manufacturing runs, allowing clients to move from smaller trial batches to larger volumes as a product range grows, alongside private-label and OEM packaging to finish a product ready for retail. Based on Rietspruit Street in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, and open weekdays from 8am to 4pm, CW Pharmaceuticals serves cosmetics and personal care brands needing formulation and manufacturing support without building their own production facility.

items.description:
Delta 5 Magalieskruin has repaired and sold computers and game consoles since 1995, starting as the idea of two people who spotted a gap in the fast-growing gaming market. Today the business handles repairs and sales across Nintendo, PlayStation and Xbox consoles, controllers, laptops and desktop PCs, and has grown into one of the country's leading third-party repair centres for gaming hardware.

The company supplies spares and components for consoles and laptops, along with soldering and electronics repair equipment aimed at both home hobbyists and professional repairers, and runs a fetch-repair-return service alongside its online shop. Delta 5 operates from its Magalieskruin head office as well as a second branch at Highlands Centre in Lyttelton, Centurion, serving gamers and PC owners across Pretoria and Centurion who need hardware repaired, upgraded or sourced from a specialist rather than a general electronics store.
